title: Native geometric realization preserves ambient derived internal Hom
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field, let $\ell\ne\mathrm{char}(k_0)$ be prime, and let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme. Write $Y=X\times_{k_0}\overline{k_0}$. Use the native abelian Weil sheaf category $\mathcal W_X$, its ordinary derived category, and its actual product-total derived Hom from [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations]. Put $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and let $R_Y=p_Y^*\underline\Omega$ be the pulled-back finite-subextension-valued condensed coefficient ring, canonically isomorphic to the native continuous coefficient sheaf by [lem-sf-locally-finite-coefficient-ring-realization]. Let $U:D(\mathcal W_X)\to D(\mathrm{Mod}(R_Y))$ be the exact functor forgetting Frobenius and scalar linearity, then restricting along nativeModuleCoefficientIso, namely nativeGeometricForget from [lem-sf-weil-geometric-hom-constructibility]. For arbitrary, possibly unbounded, $K,L\in D(\mathcal W_X)$ there exists an isomorphism $U(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal W_X}(K,L))\cong R\mathcal Hom_{R_Y}(UK,UL)$. The right side is the existing CondensedRing.derivedHom in the ordinary geometric derived category. No boundedness, constructibility, dualizing-object, or reflexivity assertion is part of this statement.

proof.text: Let F be AdicSheaf.forgetAb followed by comap along nativeModuleCoefficientIso. The first factor is an equivalence by [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-equivalence], and the second is restriction along a ring isomorphism from [lem-sf-weil-verdier-module-constructibility-comparison]. Therefore F and its termwise derived functor are equivalences. For each fixed ordinary source P, apply [lem-sf-native-coefficient-tensor-comparison] to C.ordinaryTensorModels to obtain tensorRight(P) followed by F is naturally isomorphic to F followed by condensed tensorLeft(FP).

proof.text: The ordinary adjunction from C and the condensed tensor-Hom adjunction of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom] have isomorphic left adjoints after composing with the coefficient equivalence. Mathlib conjugateIsoEquiv gives an isomorphism of the composed right adjoints. Evaluate at FQ, apply F, and cancel the unit and counit of the equivalence. Explicitly compose F(H(unit_Q)), F of the conjugate comparison at FQ, and counit at condensed Hom(FP,FQ). This identifies F of ordinary Hom(P,Q) with condensed Hom(FP,FQ). Whisker the isomorphism of step 1 by F and compose. By definition the composite forgetting functor is nativeGeometricForget.

theorem nativeGeometricForget_derivedHomComparison
    (k₀ : Type u) [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (K L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) :
    Nonempty ((nativeGeometricForget k₀ l X).obj
        ((derivedHom k₀ l X L).obj (op K)) ≅
      ((ProEtale.CondensedRing.derivedHom (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l)
        (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber).obj
        (op ((nativeGeometricForget k₀ l X).obj K))).obj
        ((nativeGeometricForget k₀ l X).obj L))
